post_interview_reconciliation.original_question: Recall co-displays conflicting memories and their citations. When an approved current decision exists, it is marked as the winner while superseded/conflicting evidence remains visible.
post_interview_reconciliation.reconciliation: The CLI and library recall surface now co-displays conflicting approved memories with citations. An approved winner is marked by support, while contrary and superseded evidence remains visible. A citationless approved counterpart is not silently discarded: the served winner carries an explicit unverified_conflicts marker and the renderer says the result is contested. No approved candidate abstains with approval_verification; missing citation evidence abstains with citation_verification; equal supported open conflicts abstain with conflict. The implementation, adversarial fixtures, deterministic text renderer, and immutable golden samples are SHA-256 bound in the evidence bundle.

reason: GO: all four DB-04 requirements are evidenced. The F1 option-2 policy prevents silent suppression without allowing an uncited injected candidate to suppress every supported answer. Requirement 1 is satisfied by the deterministic CLI/library renderer and six golden samples; requirements 2 and 3 are covered by the adversarial and acceptance tests; requirement 4 is satisfied by the SHA-256 evidence bundle and the independent Product owner and Trust approver signatures required by the decision contract.
